channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: Google, Apple, and Microsoft warn some visa holders not to leave the US due to 'significant' return delays of up to a year
item.description: The US State Department said it was "prioritizing thoroughly vetting" each visa case, which could cause delays.

item.title: iRobot founder says company's bankruptcy revealed a new kind of competitor: 'the Chinese fast follower'
item.description: As iRobot's founder Colin Angle looks back on its path to bankruptcy, he says it was hard to overcome competitors in China.

item.title: I performed for thousands at Disneyland — now I try to recreate that same spark of magic in my business
item.description: Lee Wan Yu, a former Disneyland parade dancer, shares a behind-the-scenes look at the audition process and what she learned from Disney's magic.

item.title: This millennial dreamed of owning his own food business. He did it — but he's facing one big problem.
item.description: Jonas Koh fulfilled his dream of starting a nasi lemak hawker stall. But in an area filled with a frugal older crowd, he's struggling to get sales up.

item.title: Waymo resumes service following San Francisco blackout that left its driverless taxis confused
item.description: A widespread power outage in San Francisco affected thousands of residents. It also left Waymo robotaxis stalled on city streets.

item.title: They left their jobs in their 50s to reconnect with their kids. It helped them rethink their long-term career plans.
item.description: Karen Gilchrist jokes that her "maternal instincts kicked in late," but by 2024 she and her husband, Pablo Slough, decided to prioritize family over climbing the corporate ladder.

item.title: Read the memos Google, Apple, Microsoft, and ServiceNow sent visa workers warning them not to travel
item.description: The US is now reviewing the social media of some visa applicants. Several major tech companies are warning visa holders not to leave the country.

item.title: Turkey wants to make its first aircraft carrier longer, even after beating the UK and France at ship length
item.description: At a revised 984 feet, the new Turkish ship would approach the length range of the American Nimitz and Ford-class carriers.

item.title: Martha Stewart, 84, still works out every weekday — and says her routine hasn't changed much in decades
item.description: Outside the gym, Martha Stewart says she tries to stay active by walking, gardening, and working.

item.title: AI is creating a security problem most companies aren't staffed to handle, says an AI researcher
item.description: An AI security researcher says companies lack the talent to handle AI security problems — and traditional cybersecurity teams aren't enough.
